value.rationale: Worst-case path length per unit total road/network length is a natural metric-network bottleneck measure. This is a complete real-parameter, all-order classification for canonical highly redundant wheel networks, with an odd-order middle regime and a provably sharp order-parity law for the normalized worst bottleneck. The exceptional order-three flat optimum and exact length ratios provide nontrivial design comparisons that vertex-only graph diameter cannot supply.
